bindings.caption: Heat ZnO precursor in He + O2 atmosphere until sublimed. temperature: 1400 °C. Recipe-level reported vessel: gas atmosphere (He + O2). No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Cool and condense ZnO vapor into nanocrystalline particles. Recipe-level reported vessel: gas atmosphere (He + O2). No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Collect particles on cold finger. Recipe-level reported vessel: gas atmosphere (He + O2). No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Anneal particles in air at 300 °C for 4 h. temperature: 300 °C. duration: 4 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: gas atmosphere (He + O2). No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
